questions.stem: For femoral nerve block, how far down the thigh does the skin cover extend?
options: Down to and including the knee

questions.stem: How reliable is femoral nerve block for skin of the medial leg and foot?
questions.answer: Variable: only a strip of skin is covered.

questions.stem: Which joints does the femoral nerve supply, relevant to femoral nerve block?
Which surgery is femoral nerve block indicated for?
options: Surgery on the knee, anterior thigh and medial lower leg

questions.answer: Light probe pressure, with colour Doppler if needed.

questions.stem: Why avoid heavy probe pressure in femoral nerve block ultrasound?
questions.answer: It compresses tissue, makes injection harder, and may limit fascial spread.

questions.stem: What are two vascular complications of femoral nerve block?
questions.answer: Intravascular injection or femoral artery puncture.

questions.stem: What complication can intrafascicular injection cause in femoral nerve block?

It always blocks the sciatic nerve
It rarely reaches the obturator nerve
